source: Written by hand (task T12) in the shape of what pytest -q and node --test-reporter=tap print inside the tools image; the real-engine test (tests/docker/semantic-tests-pytest.test.js) records what the image printed and replaces them.
matching: The first run whose runner is the container's recipe, whose file is the test file, whose dependencies flag (when set) says whether a dependency volume is mounted, and whose when-conditions (a tree file that contains / lacks a text) all hold.
